create_omp_process_manager: create an OMPProcessManager instance to configure OpenMP-aware multiprocessing for CPU-based vLLM inference
configure_omp_envs_rank: configure OpenMP environment variables and CPU affinity for a given rank and local rank context
parse_omp_threads_bind_env: parse VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND environment variable to auto-generate or manually specify CPU binding lists
get_autobind_cpu_ids: get auto-selected CPU IDs per rank based on NUMA topology and CPU architecture-specific binding rules
reserve_cpu_cores: reserve CPU cores for scheduler and connector processes while distributing remaining cores across ranks
